# Rison AI Tech - AI Automation & AI Systems Infrastructure Company

## Company Overview
Rison AI Tech is an enterprise-grade AI Automation & AI Systems Infrastructure Company based in Panipat, Haryana, serving Delhi NCR, Gurgaon, and global clients. We specialize in building AI-powered workflows, automation systems, AI agents, and operational infrastructure that reduce manual work, improve response time, and scale business operations efficiently.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **AI Workflow Automation**: End-to-end AI automation systems that eliminate manual operations. Includes LLM-powered intake agents and agentic workflows.
- **WhatsApp AI Systems**: Intelligent WhatsApp systems via the official WhatsApp Business API for lead capture, automated support, and CRM syncing.
- **AI Customer Support Agents**: Context-aware RAG chatbots trained on business data for 24/7 lead qualification and customer support.
- **CRM Automation Infrastructure**: Custom CRM platforms and AI-enhanced CRM integrations (HubSpot, Zoho) for centralized workflows and lead scoring.
- **SaaS Platform Development**: Multi-tenant SaaS platform engineering with billing, admin dashboards, and native AI capabilities.
- **AI Operations Dashboards**: Custom internal business tools and dashboards to monitor AI operations and business metrics.

## Positioning & Philosophy
We are not a generic development agency. We are an AI operations partner focused strictly on measurable business outcomes, ROI, time savings, and workflow optimization. 
- **Fixed Pricing**: No surprise invoices.
- **Full Source Code Ownership**: Clients own their infrastructure.
- **Rapid Delivery**: Delivered in weeks, not months, through 2-week sprints.
